_comment: The agent writes here instead of guessing on anything ambiguous or hard-gated. Empty items = nothing blocking the builder.

items.summary: 117 of 148 built pages are THIN (1-2 clinics) — many treatment x city combos in smaller municipalities have only one provider. They pass the COMPLIANCE quality gate (real, rated, unique, schema, consent), so per 'build what passes' they are built. But thin pages rank poorly.
items.decision: To hold thin pages, add a 'completeness' block to config/thresholds.json (operator-owned; builder cannot edit config). With min_page_requirements.min_listings = 3, the builder would HOLD the 117 thin pages and ship only the ~31 robust ones. Builder runs DRY-RUN until that block exists.
items.alternative: Deepen the thin cities to >=3 real rated clinics each (more prospecting + a ratings pass) so they pass on their own merits rather than being held.

items.summary: Fully-rated national directory (148 pages, 40 cities, 3 counties) is built and committed to auto/build. Deploy is the separate, human-gated step (Vercel/Cloudflare) — the builder does not deploy. After deploy: connect Search Console, submit /sitemap.xml, request indexing.

_resolved: places-mcp-not-visible-to-builder — RESOLVED: ratings supplied via permitted Places API; clinics.json fully rated (97/97, rating_source=google_places).

operator-add-geo-tree — partial: operator expanded seed_scope.neighborhoods to 40; builder derives correct counties via CITY_COUNTY map (Miami-Dade/Broward/Palm Beach). A full seed_scope.geo tree with status flags is still the cleaner long-term control.
